name: Casting off — Cra-Zi Landing
open: Lines off. Forty fares booked for Nowhere. Three days. It is always three days.

name: The Hippo Shallows
open: Brown backs surfacing in the shallows, and the channel narrowing to something a piano could touch both sides of.

name: The Narrow Cut
open: Two walls of black rock and a bend you cannot see past. No reverse. We're going in.

settle_stages.text: A steam launch on her side in the mud, listing hard, boiler still faintly hissing. Nobody has ever come back for her.
The Calliope is down to her rail now. Stack still standing. Still, faintly, venting.
A stub of stack and some birds. You have to know where to look, and you do.

name: Ilostmi Mine
open: Dead end. The adit is a cul-de-sac and the Ginny will not back out. The only way home is the way you came — you turn her with the helm while you still have way on, or the wall turns her for you. There is ore if you get out clean.
brief: She will not reverse. Almost every beat belongs on the helm. A joke is a luxury. The buckets will not turn the boat.

station_copy.steer: Helm over. No reverse — you are turning her with what way she has left. The wall is still there.
station_copy.wrench: You go below. The wall does not care that you are oiling something.
station_copy.bail: You hand out buckets in a hole with one exit. The water goes down. The boat does not turn.

name: The Reach
open: Open water. The chart is generous about this stretch, in wording it clearly did not read back.

name: The Snag Field
sub: The chart does not mention a fence
open: Timber in the channel, laid down like a fence somebody forgot to take in. You will duck. They will look at the wrong thing.

name: Crocodile Bend
open: The chart marks this stretch CROCODILE. The water is empty. The passengers came for teeth. They have opinions about the lack of teeth.

name: The Old Race
sub: The mill is gone. The water is not.
open: A mill race with the mill long gone. The water still thinks it has a job, and it is doing that job at you.

name: The Unnamed Shrine
sub: A landing. A name that isn't on the chart.
open: A stone landing and a shrine to a name that isn't written down. They want a photograph of something they cannot spell.

name: Knight Falls
open: There it is. Nine feet of water falling nine feet. Forty passengers who paid for a legend.

station_copy.bail: This expedition is going underwater, fast.
station_copy.steer: The falls are not a channel. You keep her pointed downstream. The gauge eases. You are not parked.
station_copy.wrench: You go below during the advertised bit. They came for a waterfall.
